    • College Library

    The Morgan Zintec College Library catalogue runs on our Koha Integrated Library System, accessible from any computer connected to the campus network.

    Open Koha Catalogue Contact Library

    Koha Library System

    Our library uses Koha, a world-class open-source Integrated Library System (ILS) used by libraries worldwide. The system provides a comprehensive platform for managing all library operations and providing seamless access to resources for students and staff.

    Search & Discovery

    Search by title, author, subject, ISBN, or keyword across all library holdings. Advanced search options for precise results.

    Browse Collections

    Explore curated collections by subject: Education, Humanities, Sciences, ICT, Professional Studies, and more.

    My Account

    View checked-out items, due dates, fines, and reading history. Place holds and renew items online.

    Digital Resources

    Access e-books, academic journals, research databases, and theses/dissertations from the digital repository.

    Reservations & Renewals

    Reserve books currently on loan. Renew eligible items online before due dates.

    Mobile Access

    Responsive interface works on all devices. Scan QR codes in the library for quick catalogue access.

    Access Information

    On campus: Open the Koha Catalogue from any campus workstation or the campus Wi-Fi network.

    Off campus: Contact the Library or ICT Department for remote access details and VPN setup.

    System Capabilities

    Koha Features for Our Community

    Powerful tools for students, lecturers, and researchers

    For Students

    • Search course reserves
    • View reading lists
    • Request inter-library loans
    • Citation export (APA, MLA, etc.)
    • Mobile-friendly interface
    • Reading history & recommendations

    For Lecturers

    • Create course reading lists
    • Track student resource usage
    • Request new acquisitions
    • Embed resources in eLearning
    • Research impact metrics
    • Reserve items for classes

    For Researchers

    • Advanced search & filters
    • Saved searches & alerts
    • Theses & dissertations access
    • Journal article linking
    • Data export for analysis
    • ORCID integration ready
